benefits.title: Parcel room access
benefits.body: Secure parcel collection is available daily from 06:00 to 22:00 with your resident access card.

benefits.title: Shared work lounge
benefits.body: Residents may use the level 02 work lounge. Quiet sessions need no booking; meeting rooms require a reservation.

benefits.title: Bicycle storage
benefits.body: Registered residents can request a numbered bicycle space from the building desk.

benefits.title: Move-in coordination
benefits.body: Book lift protection and loading access at least two working days before a move.
